sentences.text: This is first bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of temporary bail in connection with crime No.149/2023 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Industrial Area District - Ratlam for offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 120-B of IPC mainly on the ground of marriage of the applicant.
2. According to the marriage card, the marriage of the applicant is scheduled to take place from 15/1/2025 to 17/1/2025.
Counsel for the State was granted time to verify the factum of marriage.
However, the verification report has yet not been received.
He prays for further time to verify.

3. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the date of marriage and the fact that there are holidays upto 14/1/2025, the application for grant of temporary bail is allowed for period of 15 days from the date of release subject to verification of factum of marriage by the trial Court and if the same is found to be correct the applicant shall be released on bail.

4. It is directed that applicant Shailesh shall be released from custody upon NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:735 2 MCRC-54170-2024 for a period of 15 days from the date of release upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
The applicant shall surrender immediately after expiry of period of 15 days.
If the applicant do not surrender the Trial Court shall be at liberty to take steps to secure his arrest in accordance with law.
